haiku.problem: "What did He say the people had made it?" is awkward and not clear English. "Made it" needs a complement, such as "made it into" or "turned it into."

"Jesus taught that when you stand to pray and hold something against another person, what should you do?" is hard to read. The "taught that" clause runs into a separate question. It needs a cleaner sentence, such as "When you stand to pray and hold something against someone, what did Jesus say to do?"
